test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The internal and external diameters of a hollow hemispherical bowl are 6 cm and 10 cm, respectively. If it is melted and recast into a solid cylinder of diameter 14 cm, what is the height of the cylinder in cm?
solution:
Given:

The internal and external diameters of a hollow hemispherical bowl are 6 cm and 10 cm

Concept used:

The volume of a hollow hemisphere = The volume of a solid cylinder (Where R is the radius)

The volume of a hollow hemisphere = 2/3π(R³ - r³) (Where R is the radius)

Radius = Diameter ÷ 2

The volume of a solid cylinder = πr²h

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d688739f1f5ab5a57eb2ab9c394736ccc4676ea31c9af3f4213696606ac8edf.png] 

The volume of a hollow hemisphere = 2/3π(R3 - r3)

⇒ 2/3 × π × (53 - 33)

⇒ 2/3 × π × 98

The volume of a solid cylinder = πr2h

⇒ πr2h = π72h 

⇒ 2/3 × π × 98 = π × 7² × h

⇒ h = 4/3

⇒ h = 1.33

**The height of the cylinder in cm is 1.33.**
